heads.t: 賓士認Level 3推出太早！實用性不如預期 目標2030年攻Level 4 Mercedes-Benz曾經是全球自動駕駛技術發展最積極的汽車製造商之一，2023年更憑藉Drive Pilot系統，成為首家在美國取得Level 3自動駕駛技術核准的車廠，然而這項原本被視為品牌科技實力象徵的技術，如今卻面臨策略轉變，Mercedes-Benz技術長Jörg Burzer近日坦言，品牌當初推出Level 3系統的時間可能太早，實際使用條件與消費者需求之間存在明顯落差。因此，Mercedes-Benz決定重新調整自動駕駛發展方向，不再將Level 3視為當前主要目標，而是優先強化Level…
heads.en: The target of 2030 for Level 4 Mercedes-Benz was one of the world's most active car manufacturers in the development of auto-driving technology, and 2023, thanks to the Drive Pilot system, became the first car factory to obtain a Level 3 auto-drive approval in the United States, yet this technology, which was originally considered to be a brand-based technology reality, is now facing a strategic change, with the recent absolutism of the technology director, Mercedes-Benz, Jörg Burzer, that the brand might have introduced the Level 3 system too soon, and that there is a clear difference between the actual usage and the consumer's needs. So, Mercedes-Benz decided to re-route the autopilot, not to see Level 3 as the main objective, but to give it priority...
